applicationFields.title: Aerospace
applicationFields.description: PEEK is widely used in the aerospace industry, mainly replacing aluminum and other metal materials to manufacture various aircraft parts and reduce the severity of fire hazards. Thanks to its excellent properties, PEEK can be used to make fuel filter screens, bolts, nuts and wire conduits, cabin seats and tables, cabin skin, cable trays and electrical components, cabin door handles, compressors and pump bodies, and other parts.

applicationFields.title: Transportation
applicationFields.description: Performance advantages in this field: good machinability, flame retardancy, non-toxicity, wear resistance, corrosion resistance and low particle shedding. When more than 3-4 of these performance advantages are required simultaneously under most application conditions, polyetheretherketone (PEEK) is the material of first choice.

peek-piston-ring.title: PEEK Compressor Piston Rings
paragraphs: Product name: PEEK compressor piston ring

The emergence of PEEK (polyetheretherketone) has opened up a new path for the sealing technology of reciprocating compressors. Through repeated design, testing and evaluation of medium- and high-pressure differential piston rings at high temperature and pressure, a practical technology with new materials, new designs and new processes has been developed that is feasible, reliable and suitable for long-term operation.
Product advantages:
(1) High strength: The mechanical properties of PEEK are far superior to those of PTFE, making it a high-strength resin material.

(2) Both toughness and rigidity: With good balance and hardness, piston rings under high pressure do not deform or shed material under reciprocating impact. Rings for low pressure differentials do not require elastic rings and can automatically press against the cylinder wall.
(3) Fatigue resistance, creep resistance and no cold flow.
Under alternating stress loads, its excellent fatigue resistance is the best among all plastics and comparable to aluminum alloys. Its rigidity remains good below 260°C.

(4) Heat resistance: The reinforced heat deflection temperature can reach over 300°C. The theoretical continuous use temperature is measured at 260°C. 160°C is the higher parameter of the compressor design value; as the temperature rises further, the mechanical properties of PEEK decrease linearly.

(5) Wear resistance: Among all plastics, PEEK has excellent sliding characteristics. The friction coefficient of piston rings produced by Changchun Tianhang is between 0.15 and 0.30, suitable for applications requiring low friction coefficient and wear resistance, and is not prone to damaging the mating surface.
(6) Low coefficient of expansion
(7) PV value: It varies with speed, temperature, load and the mating surface, and is several times greater than commonly used polymer materials.
(8) Corrosion resistance: It dissolves only in concentrated sulfuric acid among acids and bases, and is unaffected by common chemicals.

peek-valve-plate.title: PEEK Compressor Valve Plates
paragraphs: PEEK valve plates have low density and low elastic modulus, reducing impact force and the resulting fatigue damage, greatly extending valve life — under normal conditions far exceeding metal valve plates. They provide good sealing performance with reduced gas leakage and excellent running-in characteristics. Flow characteristics are superior to similar metal valve plates, reducing energy loss caused by gas friction in the valve gap; valve energy consumption can be reduced by 5%-10%. They withstand impacts from solid particles and droplets. Crack propagation after valve plate fracture is slow, and even if a broken plate falls into the cylinder, it will not damage the cylinder. Operating noise is low, and with good self-lubrication, they are suitable for both oil-lubricated and oil-free conditions.

peek-catheter.title: Production, Applications and Development of PEEK Catheters in the Medical Field
paragraphs: Localization of raw materials

Current status: PEEK raw materials previously relied on imports from Invibio (UK), Evonik (Germany) and Victrex (UK). Now Jilin University and Zhongyan already produce and sell in bulk, and Shandong Junhao has started construction in Shandong, with mass production expected in 2021.
Physical and chemical properties of PEEK

(1) A low elastic modulus close to that of bone (PEEK ~3.8 GPa, cancellous bone 3.2-7.8 GPa, cortical bone 17-20 GPa, titanium alloy TC4 ~110 GPa) prevents stress-shielding effects and helps surrounding bone maintain its original strength.

(2) X-ray transmissibility: PEEK does not show up on CT and MRI scans, making it easy to assess bone growth and healing; when visualization of the implant is needed in some cases, this can also be achieved through modification. In addition, PEEK has strong radiation resistance — with a very stable chemical structure, PEEK parts work normally even under high doses of ionizing radiation.

(3) Excellent sterilization performance: even with prolonged exposure to steam, ethylene oxide and gamma rays, its original properties remain unchanged. It can be used continuously at temperatures up to 250°C, with transient use up to 300°C.
(4) Good biocompatibility.
(5) Adjustable mechanical properties: different additives can be incorporated, including carbon fiber, barium sulfate and glass fiber, to meet specific application requirements.
(6) Greater design freedom: parts can be easily machined from semi-finished blanks or produced by injection molding; PEEK can be processed by injection molding, extrusion and 3D printing.
Current applications in orthopedic medical devices:
Sports medicine, joint fields, craniomaxillofacial surgery and interspinous devices.
Companies currently involved in this field, such as MDT, Depuy, Jiangsu Junhua and Smith & Nephew, are all engaged in R&D and production.
Injection molding and extrusion processes that meet biocompatibility requirements are a major direction.
